rng: SHA256 canonical JSON [seed,round,userLogicalIndex,visitIndex,drawKind]; first 13 hex digits / 2^52. Never branch, run, real resource ID or model-call count.
profile: Round zero draws set category, maximum stated budget, latent price sensitivity and preferred copy length. Only actual shopper query/category and budget are revealed to APIs; latent coefficients and response probabilities are never sent to Merchant.
copy_fit: 0.15 + 0.55*fraction_of_this_SKU_attributes_mentioned + 0.30*preferred_length_match; capped [0,1], identical for all branches. Attributes are the advertised SKU's own Java productName and propertyValue strings, so the scorer shares no vocabulary with any agent and no single fixed sentence scores well across the catalog. The promotion label is rendered by the display layer and is deliberately not rewarded.
category_fit: 1 when product category matches latent preference, otherwise 0.30
selection_weight: category_fit * price_fit / (position + 0.5), using the actual returned legal SKU order
purchase_probability: 0.045 * category_fit * price_fit; same exogenous purchase draw
future_payment: Explicitly scheduled for next round, with a final settlement boundary after the last traffic round; never counted as paid before Java confirms it.
pure_policy: Every branch explicitly authorizes group all and sets both assignments to rules-v1 before traffic. Old control/treatment grants do not imply all. Live recommendation interventions may only use all within their final grant.
rule_recommendation: Once only, when at least 10 actual trusted scoped REC_CLICK touches have been observed and both groups still use rules-v1, recommendation/joint switch both groups to the frozen content-v1 config through the same grant and Ads executor, citing the recommendation_clicks fact. Ad CPC clicks are not recommendation evidence. No hidden response parameter or measured revenue selects this action.
rule_ads: Existing Merchant rule_candidate through MerchantService and the same Ads executor; conservative waits and no effect remain recorded.
live_optimization: Non-fixed branches call the bounded Merchant with their fixed objective/final grant. Failed, fallback, rejected and no-action plans are retained. No replacement grant or model retry run is created to obtain an improvement.
report: Per seed/branch/repeat actual paid, refunded, net, CPC and net minus CPC; paired differences vs fixed and their range/mean/sample standard deviation. Three synthetic seeds do not establish real-world significance or revenue uplift. Record realized interventions separately from assigned branch names.
development_revision: Before any formal-scale run: distinguish actual recommendation clicks from ad CPC clicks for policy maturity. The original v1 protocol and its smoke outputs remain in Git; no seed, opportunity draw, probability coefficient, budget or expected revenue was changed.
v3_revision: The v2 copy_quality term scored the literal words 规格/用途 and a 推广 prefix, which the Merchant rule baseline's fixed sentence matched on every item. Scorer and subject shared one word list, so branch differences measured word faces rather than copy quality, and the term rewarded agents for retyping the ad label. v3 scores against the advertised SKU's own attributes instead. Seeds, draws, category/price/purchase/refund coefficients and budgets are unchanged. The v2 smoke outputs (eval-comparison-smoke-v14, -v15) remain in Git but were produced under the old click model and are not comparable to v3 runs.
